killedBy: About & Legal heading structure (issue #117) nests every document section under the document, and skips no level
the legal block renderer renders every block kind the generator can emit, and the shipped data uses all of them
why: Restores the outline this pane shipped in draft: the document title is an h3 and so is every section inside it, so a screen reader's heading navigation is told the PolyForm licence's twenty clauses are siblings of the licence rather than parts of it. A no-skipped-levels walk cannot see it -- nothing is skipped, h1 -> h2 -> h3 -> h3 is monotonic -- which is why the case that kills this asserts the RELATIONSHIP (every section strictly deeper than its own document's title) beside the walk. Nothing visible moves either: `.hud-legal-heading` styles by class, so an h3 and an h4 render identically. MEASURED by hand before this entry existed: reverting the one ternary fails with `expected 3 to be greater than 3` on hud-legal-body-privacy.
